summary: 1950s L-4 cab on the Helena National Forest north-northeast of Helena, Montana; abandoned and gone, with no dated end.

facts.status_note: Abandoned and gone; no source describes the site now.

notes_for_editor: Only one dated source for the structure: '1950s' with no year, so no build or abandonment event is recorded; the story says 1950s. The record's kind 'ground' matches the Forest Fire Lookout Association type and the 'L-4 cab' wording, so no correction is proposed. The Montana Forest Lookouts page gives a township-range locator only. Searches found a 2025 wildfire called the Hilger Valley Fire north of Helena; no source links it to this lookout, so the story does not mention it. No staffing, fire or access information found; no visit fields recorded.
